Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1097
Claimant:
Todd Lee
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
09/13/2023
Claim opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The adjuster confirmed the
policy was active and the reporting driver is named on the policy.
09/14/2023
Photos taken at the scene confirm some details of the impact, including the position of both vehicles after the
collision. No independent witnesses have come forward to the adjuster.
11/03/2023
Vehicle damage to the rear of the insured's car matches the described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is
known from prior claims or inspection notes.
12/02/2023
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The adjuster has requested the prior policy
history to close this point.
12/11/2023
The claimant, now represented by counsel, gave a recorded statement describing neck pain shortly after the impact.
The account has been consistent with what the claimant told the adjuster in every earlier conversation.
01/06/2024
It is not fully clear from the claimant's description or the photos where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting at the
moment of impact. The adjuster has asked counsel for a setaing diagram.
01/29/2024
Medical records show a diagnosis of whiplash. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash, and the
treating physician's causation opinion has been requested.
02/09/2024
The records show no earlier injury to the same area of the neck or upper back. The adjuster has noted this for the file.
02/16/2024
Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury, with physical therapy and medication. Visits tapered off as
the patient improved.
02/27/2024
Counsel submitted a demand package with treatment bills and wage documentation. The adjuster is reviewing the
bills against the records and the timeline of care.
02/29/2024
File remains open pending the causation opinion and review of the demand. The adjuster will reassess reesrves once
those items are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
